unit: animator: scene authors, Reiniger rig, multiplane, stencil dye, pan exposure (SCIONs 2, 29 (cut), 32 (FK), 44)

module.usage: python3 -I cut.py; python3 -I scene.py testshot; python3 -I beats.py; python3 -I scenes_json.py. Editor: clips are 960x540, 24 fps, 36 frames (1.5 s), silent, no type; or import beats and call the frame functions.

methods.stencil: Each plate printed monochrome on its own hard curve (p1 -> black, p99.6 -> paper) and dyed through masks keyed from the plate's hues: grass (yellow-green/mid/deep green by original hue, density from the print, cream on the hottest blades), soil (ochre, red earth in the darker half), brick quoins red, plaster yellow-ochre, trees deep green, sky left cream paper. Coat: #e2011b over a print stretched on the coat's own p2..p98.5 so the folds stay; warm sheen on the top 12%. Key brass, bell bronze. Masks saved in dye/.
methods.multiplane: Long planes assembled from distinct crops of the two Bourre plates joined by 72 px cross-fades (no mirror tiling); far 0.35 / mid 0.6 / bench 0.8 / figure 1.0 / near 1.6; the camera tilted down so no sky enters V.3.
methods.pan_exposure: Every frame = mean of n sub-frames over a 180-degree shutter (1/48 s). Streak length per plane = ratio x camera speed / 48. No blur kernel on any picture (contact-shadow and stencil-edge masks are softened, never the image).
methods.rig: Reiniger/FK: all runner pieces share the photo's pixel frame; child transform = parent @ T(pivot - child_pivot) @ R(child_pivot, angle) @ S; angle limits clamp every pose. Replacement profiles for the visitor (front walking in, back walking off).
methods.test_shot_fixes: (1) runner actually runs: new knee joint below the hem (thigh 460->700, shin hinged there, 1.75 stretch), hip -35..40, knee -75..0, 2.3 Hz stride, forward lean -10 deg, sleeve and forearm swing in counter-phase, coat tails swing at the waist; (2) coat keeps its folds (local p2..p98.5 stretch before the dye); (3) colour edge to edge: no sky, planes cut from grass/wall/bush bands, no mirror seams; (4) tonal range: hard print curve (true blacks), cream highlights on hot blades, ochre and red-earth soil dye in the streak; (5) English gloss in cream on a black band.

silhouette_checks.method: figures and props painted black on white, colour and stage removed; judged by eye (perceptual, not measured)
